name: Zandalarian Shadow Talisman
label: Quest
description: Zandalarian Shadow Talisman: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Impressive, friend. You have a gift for killing that I have not sensed in another in many years. Even Molthor is aware of the work that you have done for Zandalar. It is time to enhance your talisman further. Give it to me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There is only one enhancement left that can be placed on the talisman, adventurer. When the time is right, I shall apply that enhancement.
